common.preview_header: PREVIEW – nothing was sent. Show this preview to the user and wait for their explicit approval. Then repeat the call with identical arguments and confirm set to the token below.
common.confirm_true_rejected: Write refused: confirm=true is not accepted. Call the tool first without confirm to get a preview and a confirmation token, show the preview to the user, and after their approval repeat the call with confirm set to that token.
common.confirm_token_invalid: Write refused: the confirmation token does not match these arguments (the arguments changed or the token belongs to another call). Call the tool without confirm to get a new preview, show it to the user and confirm with the new token.
